channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Lake Champlain’s lake monster, Champ, will appear on a twenty twenty-seven USPS mythical creature stamp. It will be one of five creatures featured on forever stamps. The Postal Service has not announced the release date or locations yet.

Northern New York is set to receive state funds for road repaving and revitalization projects. Assemblymember Michael S. Cashman urges eligible residents to apply for the Home Energy Assistance Program. The program helps with heating costs during the winter months.

New York advocates warn a USDA proposal could cut SNAP benefits for thousands of families. The change may also disrupt child nutrition programs tied to SNAP. There are concerns this will worsen the hunger crisis in New York.

The Vermont Department of Labor is highlighting career and training resources for veterans this Veterans Day. Veterans can access free services like career guidance and job search help at local Job Centers. Programs include SkillBridge and support through the Jobs for Veterans State Grant.
